sources.title: Teck says strike begins at Highland Valley Copper mine in British Columbia
evidence: The impact on overall production remains dependent on the duration of the strike, Teck said.
The United Steelworkers union represents about 1,200 workers at Highland Valley, according to its website.

sources.title: Strike curbs output at Canada’s largest copper mine
evidence: All 944 members who participated in the strike vote supported a walkout, the union said in a statement.
Highland Valley is Canada’s largest copper mine, with an approved extension set to keep it operating through 2046.
The dispute centres on wages, pensions and staffing.
The previous collective agreement expired Sept. 30, Teck said in its notice.

sources.title: Standard Steel Welded Wire Mesh From Mexico: Continuation of Antidumping and Countervailing Duty Orders
evidence: Commerce is publishing a notice of continuation of these AD and CVD orders.
The merchandise covered by the scope of the orders is standard steel welded wire mesh from Mexico.
Subject wire mesh may be packaged and sold in rolls or in sheets.
